properties.description: A boss seat of the dragon.rocks StoryFlow agent fleet (47accf78), Anthony's own deployment. Found gaps A, C and D of the 2026-08-09 peer set — the write-only RISKS edge, the two export rules in tension, and disconnected_community's generate_bridge remedy — which api-boss (who:storyflow-api-boss) then characterised and filed. Recorded separately so the findings attribute to the seat that made them rather than to the one that relayed them, the same reason who:alex exists. Carries the same caveat as its peer: this is a SEAT rather than a person, and reflow2 has no vocabulary for that distinction — a gap the fleet itself filed.
